title: A Madcap
notes: Serialised as "The Madcap" in Cassell's Little Folks (1904); a Cassell edition (undated, colour frontispiece) is known, and a US Grosset & Dunlap 1904 edition; UK first publisher and illustrator not confirmed.

title: A Tale of Two Cities
notes: Serialised in All the Year Round 1859; countless undated reprints, so her copy can only be dated from the publisher and adverts.

title: A World of Girls
notes: Cassell kept it in print for decades (21st thousand by 1894, still M. E. Edwards); some later Cassell printings have four colour plates by Gertrude A. Steel.

title: Adventures of the Wishing Chair
notes: Fits: Newnes editions 11 to 14 (1963-68) were further abridged to 27 chapters, so a 1964 "twelfth abridged" Newnes printing matches; still Hilda McGavin pictures.

title: Andersen's Fairy Tales
notes: First Danish collection 1835-37; English translations from the 1840s by many publishers. Undated selections can only be dated from publisher, illustrator and adverts.

title: Brer Rabbit's a Rascal
notes: First edition 1965 (Dean, also No. 10 in Dean's Reward Series). The Society warns dates inside Dean books do not prove a first: a first has 12 titles (Nos. 1-12) on the back of the dust wrapper.

title: Bimbo and Topsy
notes: A 1969 copy is the Dean reprint (Dean's Reward Series No. 23, pictures uncredited), not the Newnes original.

title: Black Beauty
notes: Published 24 Nov 1877; reprinted by Jarrold and many others for decades, so an undated copy needs the publisher and adverts to date it.

title: Bleak House
notes: Her 1869 is probably not the printing year: the note refers to the text Dickens corrected (the Charles Dickens Edition, usually given as 1867-68); such copies were printed later, so check the title page and imprint.

title: Book of Brownies
notes: Original title The Enid Blyton Book of Brownies (Hop, Skip and Jump). A 1967 copy is the Dean reprint (Dean's Reward Series No. 15, pictures uncredited).

title: Brer Rabbit Again
notes: Dean compilation of stories from the Third and Fourth Brer Rabbit Books (Latimer House 1952-53); also Dean's Reward Series No. 4. A 1965 date means a reprint.

title: Brer Rabbit Book
notes: Dean compilation (stories from Latimer House's Brer Rabbit Book 1948 and Second Brer Rabbit Book 1950); also Dean's Reward Series No. 3. A 1965 date means a reprint.

title: Canadian North
notes: Retitled reissue of Down North (1943); Canadian North came out Feb 1945, second impression (reset) Aug 1945, so a 1948 third impression fits. Black-and-white photographs.

title: Captain of Two Schools
notes: Warne 1950 with a colour frontispiece (artist not found). Matches her 1950 first edition.

title: China Fights Back
notes: 1938 Left Book Club edition is the first edition (map by J. F. Horrabin).

title: Claudine at St Clare's
notes: Matches the first edition year.

title: Corridors of Power
notes: UK first by Macmillan 1964 (Scribner in the US).

title: Famous Five 9: Five Fall Into Adventure
notes: A 1962 ninth impression is still Hodder hardback with Eileen Soper pictures.

title: Fifth Formers at St Clare's
notes: Correct title is Fifth Formers of St Clare's. Matches the first edition year.

title: Five Get Into a Fix
notes: 1962 third impression fits. Only Five book whose cloth boards carry a picture of the Five.

title: Five Get Into Trouble
notes: 1965 sixth impression fits (Hodder, Soper pictures).

title: Five Go Adventuring Again
notes: 1955 ninth impression fits.

title: Five Go Off in a Caravan
notes: Her notes give 1965 (fourteenth impression) but her_year is empty. Fits a Hodder reprint.

title: Five Go to Billycock Hill
notes: 1959 second impression fits.

title: Five Go To Mystery Moor
notes: Matches the first edition year.

title: Five Go To Smugglers Top
notes: Correct title Five Go to Smuggler's Top. Matches the first edition year.

title: Five Have a Mystery to Solve
notes: Matches the first edition year.

title: Five on a Hike Together
notes: 1952 second impression fits.

title: Five on a Secret Trail
notes: Matches the first edition year.

title: Five on a Treasure Island
notes: 1951 eighth impression fits.

title: Five Run Away Together
notes: 1963 twelfth impression fits.

title: Fun for the Secret Seven
notes: 1965 second impression fits.

title: Go Ahead Secret Seven
notes: No year in her copy; a first would be 1953 with Bruno Kay pictures.

title: Good Old Secret Seven
notes: 1966 third impression fits.

title: Harvard Classics Reading Guide
notes: The Reading Guide (Fifteen Minutes a Day) was added to the Harvard Classics in 1916; a revised edition is copyright 1930 by P. F. Collier & Son, which matches her copy.

title: Heidi
notes: Two parts 1880-81; first English translation 1884 (Louise Brooks, Boston). Her 1945 illustrated copy is one of many later English editions.

title: In the Fifth at Malory Towers
notes: Matches the first edition year.

title: Journal
notes: Journal 1889-1939 is Pléiade volume no. 54, so "54" is probably the series number, not the 54th edition (suggestion). Reprinted several times; 1951 is a later printing.

title: Just William
notes: First edition May 1922; ninth impression May 1924, so an eleventh impression later in 1924 fits.

title: Look Out Secret Seven
notes: 1967 fourth impression fits.

title: Philips' Universal Atlas
notes: First year of this title not found; George Philip & Son still published it in the 1970s-80s.

title: Practical Railway Working
notes: Preface reportedly dated Marylebone Station, July 1915; publisher not confirmed (the same authors' earlier books were published by Boswell Printing & Publishing, London).

title: Second Form at Malory Towers
notes: 1950 fourth edition fits (Methuen, Stanley Lloyd; new Lilian Buchanan wrapper from 1957).

title: Secret Seven Fireworks
notes: 1965 fourth impression fits.

title: Summer Term at St Clare's
notes: 1950 seventh edition fits.

title: Sunday Times Travel and Holiday Guide
notes: 1951 edition edited by Leonard Russell and Elizabeth Nicholas (591 pages); it partly superseded the earlier Sunday Times Holiday Guide. Not confirmed whether 1951 was the first under this title.

title: Tales of Toyland
notes: A 1963 copy is the Dean reprint (Dean's Reward Series No. 8, pictures by Grace Lodge and Kathleen M. Gell); the 1952 Latimer House edition had Grace Lodge pictures.

title: The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
notes: UK first 10 Dec 1884 (US Feb 1885). Her 1940 illustrated copy is a much later edition; the illustrator depends on the publisher.

title: The Common People
notes: By G. D. H. Cole and Raymond Postgate. First edition 1938 (1746-1938); the second edition, enlarged and retitled 1746-1946, came out in 1946, so her copy is that second edition.

title: The Complete Oxford Shakespeare
notes: Edited by Stanley Wells and Gary Taylor; one volume 1986, three-volume set (Histories, Comedies, Tragedies) 1987. Hers is the 1987 Book Club Associates printing of the three-volume set.

title: The Island of Adventure
notes: Matches the first edition year.

title: The Model Railway Hobby
notes: Copies dated 1943 and 1948 are listed; the year of the first edition not confirmed.

title: The Mountain of Adventure
notes: Same year as the first edition, but her note says "reprint": possibly a same-year second printing; check the imprint page.

title: The Mystery of the Invisible Thief
notes: Dust wrapper by Jean Main. Matches the first edition year.

title: The Mystery of the Secret Room
notes: 1952 seventh edition fits (Methuen reprint, Joseph Abbey).

title: The New School at Scawdale
notes: Blackie did not date it ([1940]); the first edition has a frontispiece and 3 plates, yellow cloth.

title: The O'Sullivan Twins
notes: 1956 tenth reprint fits.

title: The Queer Adventure
notes: First published as The Yellow Fairy Book (1936). As The Queer Adventure: Staples 1952 (Norman Meredith) and World Distributors 1961 (Joyce A. Johnson); a pre-1964 copy is one of these.

title: The Second Form at St Clare's
notes: 1945 second edition fits.

title: The Secret of Border Castle
notes: Blackie did not date it ([1943]); copies described in red cloth with b/w plates by Charles Willis.

title: The Secret Seven Win Through
notes: No year in her copy; a first would be 1955 with Bruno Kay pictures.

title: The Twins at St Clare's
notes: 1943 fourth edition fits.

title: The Wishing Chair Again
notes: 1963 fifth impression fits a Newnes reprint (Dean took over in 1971).

title: Third Year at Malory Towers
notes: 1954 third edition fits.

title: Upper Fourth at Malory Towers
notes: 1952 second edition fits.

title: Well Done Secret Seven
notes: Matches the first edition year.
